title: "bun:test/no-export"

When another file imports from a test file, the whole test file runs, including its `test()` calls, so its tests can run as part of the importing file. Put shared helpers in a file of their own.

The rule only checks files named like tests: the name ends in `test` or `spec` before the extension, such as `cart.test.ts`, or the file is under a `__tests__` directory. A file with no `test` or `it` call can export anything. Exported types are allowed, because importing a type does not run the file.

This rule is on by default in files that import from `"bun:test"`.

## Examples

Reported:

{/* bad {"filename": "src/cart.test.ts"} */}
```ts
import { expect, test } from "bun:test";

export function makeCart() {
  return { items: [] };
}

test("starts empty", () => {
  expect(makeCart().items).toEqual([]);
});
```

Not reported, with the helper in a file of its own:

{/* file "helpers.ts" */}
```ts
export function makeCart() {
  return { items: [] };
}
```

{/* good {"filename": "cart.test.ts"} */}
```ts
import { expect, test } from "bun:test";
import { makeCart } from "./helpers";

export type Cart = ReturnType<typeof makeCart>;

test("starts empty", () => {
  expect(makeCart().items).toEqual([]);
});
```
